question: Historically, the corpuscular theory and the wave theory made contradictory predictions regarding the speed of light in water versus air. What was the specific prediction of the wave theory that was later confirmed by Foucault's experiment?

options.A: Speed of light in water is greater than in air ($v_w > v_a$)
options.B: Speed of light in water is equal to that in air ($v_w = v_a$)
options.C: Speed of light in water is less than in air ($v_w < v_a$)
options.D: Speed of light is independent of the medium
